title: The Necessary Radiators
author: August Yarrow
blurb: Lior Dravenmoor, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
